## Bio

I am a postdoctoral scholar in Dr. Nancy Dennis's [Cognitive Aging and Neuroscience Laboratory (CANLAB)](https://canlab.la.psu.edu/) at Penn State - University Park, working on the neural correlates of episodic memory and aging.

I use behavioral and neuroimaging methods to understand how episodic memory changes across the adult lifespan.

Outside of research, I enjoy playing tennis, and am patiently waiting to outlive the ending of One Piece.
